# FG-GIT-0017

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_direct_push_to_a_branch_with_the_ban_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このブランチには直接 push できません。マージリクエストを作成してマージしてください。
- en: This branch cannot be pushed to directly. Open a merge request and merge it.
- id: Branch ini tidak dapat di-push secara langsung. Buat merge request lalu lakukan merge.

## 原因 (cause)

The branch is protected and a matching rule's merge rule forbids direct pushes (`protected_ref_merge_rules.direct_push_forbidden`, M3 R6, ADR-0024 §4.3, §12): a push may neither create nor move it — for every caller, administrators included (like force pushes and deletions of a protected ref). Merging a merge request is not affected (`MergeRequestMerge` does not read the ban). The whole push was refused in-band before git ran (no ref changed).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action=RepoPush`, `reason=direct_push_forbidden` and `protection` (the protection's minimum push role); on a Smart HTTP push also `refs`, `denied_refs`, `denied_codes`. Which rule bans it (read-only): GET /api/v1/projects/<id>/protected-refs (the rules with their `merge_rule`).

## 対処 (fix)

Push to a feature branch, open a merge request and merge it. A Maintainer (Owner for an Owner-level protection) lifts the ban by setting the merge rule again without `--no-direct-push` (`gstn protected-ref merge-rule set --project <id> --rule-id <n> …`) or removes it (`gstn protected-ref merge-rule remove`).
